description: Post a message into a Mattermost channel as the bot. SENDS to a real channel other people read — it goes through the permission gate. Required: channel_id and message. Optional root_id to reply inside an existing thread rather than starting a new one.

document_ids.description: Optional CallPilotAI document ids to attach. The bytes travel from storage to Mattermost; they never pass through this call. Max 25 MB per file.

message.description: Text of the message to post

root_id.description: Post id to reply to (keeps the thread together)

name: send_mattermost_message
